game.name: Kinect Adventures ! (World)(En,Ja,Fr,De,Es,It,Nl,Pt,Zh,Ko,Pl,Ru)(Rev 1)
game.desc: Kinect Adventures! is a party game for Xbox 360. The game uses Kinect, the accessory that directly recognises the player's movements. The title features five activities: ride down rapids on an inflatable boat, dive underwater in a glass cage, hit balls to destroy a wall, avoid obstacles on a wagon and blow bubbles in zero gravity.
